name: Farmstead 🐔
desc:
Farmstead is a unique multiplayer farming experience. Start with a bare plot of land that you can develop into a fully operational farm with your friends!

Everything grows offline in Farmstead!

🌾 Farm a variety of crops, animals, and unique items.
🏠 Decorate your farm with structures, decorations, gardens, and more!
⛏️ Increase your capabilities with a variety of different skills.
🍂 Unlock and explore new and unique regions.
💎 Embark on quests to earn rewards.
🎈 Invite your friends to farm and build together!

🔔 Hit the FOLLOW button to get notifications for new updates! 🔔

Developed by korky5000
In partnership with Firebrand Studios
